method: VICE 3.13.2 PAL replay from normally initialized selected levels. No RAM, register, collision-mask or instruction edits after ready snapshots. Input changes use joystick port 2. Frame requests are checked for successful completion; long waits are split at the 1000-frame tool limit. Dragon Slayer uses non-stopping hit, stair and IRQ checkpoints. Invasion also uses stopping checkpoints to inspect the first hit before and after its score award. Warp mode changes host pacing only.
setup_limit: Levels were selected through the original loader before initialization; these are within-level joystick routes, not full campaign playthroughs. Screenshots and input records are evidence; raw snapshots remain local.

dragon_slayer.start_setup: Load ready-14.vsf at $759C after original initialization; advance 220 neutral frames through normal player spawn. All following frame numbers are relative to that stopped state.

bitmap_comparison.method: Native joystick-only milestones compared with original hit callback and foreground renderer executed in strict CPU simulation. Controlled masks are used only in this separate comparison; the native replay sets joystick input only.

dragon_slayer.remaining: Collecting the final bomb and reaching this level through a complete campaign are separate, unverified routes.

no_fire_control.description: Same first-shot input timing, with fire omitted from the four-frame left pulse. The directional movement is identical.

invasion.setup: Original selected-level initialization, then 220 neutral frames for normal spawn.
invasion.fixed_replay_result: 75 points from three hits; the player is dying by the end of the same 240-frame input.
invasion.scope: Real joystick input and native VIC collision generation; the stopping capture identifies the first 25-point hit within the published finite replay.

wrong_target_hit.note: Restored pristine native hit-entry snapshot; read sprite positions and modes without reading collision latches; resumed original code to after award. No game-state edits.

pixel_check.method: Decode original 24 by 21 multicolour sprite shapes from the stopped native snapshot. Nonzero 2-bit pairs are opaque, each occupies two pixels. Confirm bank, pointers, positions, enable and expansion modes against native VIC registers. Compare all 28 sprite pairs at their stored coordinates; a common raster-row offset does not affect overlap.
pixel_check.conclusion: Shot3 overlaps alien4; aliens5 and6 overlap elsewhere. The shared $78 collision mask makes the descending target scan choose alien6, which changes from flying state1 to falling state2 and awards25 points. No projectile overlaps alien6.

checks: All13 recorded stair images and matching score/step captions
Previous/next, start/end, keyboard and accessible range values
Desktop1440, tablet768 and mobile390 layouts without overflow
